entries.zh: 有；拥有、持有（财物等）
entries.en: to have, possess

entries.zh: 立；站立、立起（设立）
entries.en: to stand; to establish
entries.notes: 音写与拉丁注污损难辨（habitor 无法解），仅依字头「立」粗定

entries.zh: 赡；供给所需、赡养（费用充足）
entries.en: to have what is necessary; to provide for, sustain

entries.zh: 持；手持、握持（拿着不放）
entries.en: to hold in the hand, grasp

entries.zh: 义；义理、在理（说话有道理）
entries.en: to have reason in what one says; righteousness, justice

entries.zh: 阻；阻止、阻拦（拦住不让）
entries.en: to hinder, obstruct; to hold back, detain

entries.zh: 节；含容于内（西语以「如孕者」作喻），音写不合，释义存疑
entries.en: joint, node; to have within itself, as a pregnant one [columns incongruent]
entries.notes: 字头「节」、音写「ſaỹ」与西语「tener dentro de si ut preñada」互不合，语义无定

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: [text damaged; gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: 字头栏[疑:忺/欣]、西语「habasitar」拼写残损、音写污损，材料不足以定夺

entries.zh: 量；器重、对人评价好（有好评）
entries.en: to think well of some; to have a good opinion of some
entries.notes: 字头「量」与「有好评」关联间接，释义主要从西语栏

entries.zh: 操；握持在手、把持
entries.en: to hold in the hand; to grasp, wield

entries.zh: 含；含在口中
entries.en: to hold in the mouth

entries.zh: 产；生育、出产（西语后半残损）
entries.en: to bear, give birth; to produce
entries.notes: 西语「tener Buenos [疑:rayes/ayres]」后半残损，依「产」定生育/出产义

entries.zh: 足；足用、够（所需的都齐）
entries.en: to have enough; to suffice, to have what is needed

entries.zh: 肚；肚腹、身孕（疑字头「剩」为「身」之误）
entries.en: belly; to be with child [character column incongruent]
entries.notes: 字头「剩」与音写「ſin」不合（疑「身」），释义从西语「tener vientre」

entries.zh: 安泰；安舒、心满意足
entries.en: to be content, at ease (L. sealed as 'to have wherewithal to pay', conflicts)
entries.notes: 西语「tener para pagar」与「安泰」不合（疑为 pagado/满意 之残），释义从汉字与音写

entries.zh: 抱头；教父怀抱教子（受洗时抱持）
entries.en: for the godfather to hold the godchild (at baptism); to hold in one's arms
entries.notes: 音写首音[疑:põ/piõ]，依西语「padrino al ahijado」与「抱」定怀抱义

entries.zh: 抱带；抱在臂弯里、用带抱携
entries.en: to carry in one's arms; to carry (slung with a band)
entries.notes: 音写[疑:piõ/põ]，西语「(tener en los braços)」与「抱」相合

entries.zh: 浮漂；浮标、漂木（漂在水上的木头）
entries.en: a float, buoy; drifting wood
entries.notes: 西语栏残损（da mente ſᵃ pagar 难解），依「浮漂/浮标」与 madera（木）定

entries.zh: 梢水；所指无定（疑为水桶「筲水」，或与船艄水路相关），西语栏残损难合
entries.en: [gloss undecidable; sau-tsui, sense uncertain]
entries.notes: 西语「tener madera mſⁿ」缩写难辨，「梢水」具体所指无定

entries.zh: 有志；有志向、怀志
entries.en: to have resolve, ambition (L. lit. 'to have everything', likely garbled)
entries.notes: 西语「tener lo todo」与「有志」不合或为转写之误，释义从汉字与音写「v chỹ」

entries.zh: 立分；所指无定——西语「在臂上有份（tener parte enel braço）」与之难合
entries.en: to have a share in the arm [columns incongruent]
entries.notes: 字头「立分」与音写「kia hun lĩp hun」内部可对，但与西语栏语义无法定夺
